SASBDB entry SASDG24  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDG24/)

Publication: Long non-coding subgenomic flavivirus RNAs have extended 3D structures and are flexible in solution.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.15252/embr.201847016

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDG24/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
